about.title: A Houston company, through and through.
text: Luke’s Plumbing & Air Conditioning has been serving Houston families for decades. This isn’t just where we work—it’s where we live. Many of our team members have been with us for years, and we’ve built our business by showing up, doing right by people, and letting our work speak for itself. From the Heights to Katy, we’ve built lasting connections in homes across the region. And we plan to keep it that way.

At Luke’s Plumbing & Air Conditioning, we treat your home like a connected system, not a patchwork of parts. Our experienced Houston home service team takes the time to understand the root of the issue and fix it the right way, the first time. Whether it’s a broken AC or a hidden leak, we bring the care, expertise, and energy to make things right.

Sure, we fix broken things. But what really keeps us going are the calls from longtime customers—and the referrals they send our way. That kind of trust doesn’t happen overnight. It’s earned over time, through honest work and the kind of service that makes people feel cared for. We’re not here to check a box and move on. We’re here to be the team you rely on, again and again.
about.imageAlt: A Luke's Plumbing & Air Conditioning service van parked outside a Houston home

values.title: Upfront Pricing
values.text: You will always know the cost before we get started. We charge by the hour, and if the job takes longer than expected, your bill stays the same.

values.title: 30-Day Money Back Guarantee
values.text: If you are not completely satisfied, call within 30 days for a refund. No questions asked.

values.title: Same Price, Any Time
values.text: We do not charge extra just because your problem showed up on a night, a weekend or a holiday.

faqs.q: How do you price your work?
faqs.a: We price things based on time. You get a clear quote before we start any work, and that quote will not change just because a job takes longer than expected. If we think a job will take two hours and it ends up taking six, that is on us.

faqs.q: What warranty comes with your work?
faqs.a: Most plumbing repairs, like toilets, drains and gas or water lines, come with a one-year warranty. For fixture replacements, like toilets, faucets and garbage disposals, we extend that coverage to two years.

faqs.q: Do you charge more for nights, weekends and holidays?
faqs.a: No. Whenever you need us, you get the same fair rate.

faqs.q: What if I am not happy with the work?
faqs.a: Give us a call within 30 days and we will make it right, or refund you completely. We would rather lose a payment than lose our reputation.
Yes. We offer flexible financing through Synchrony, with a quick application process and payment plans for an unexpected repair or a planned system upgrade.
Yes, we accept insurance, and we back all of our work with strong warranties.

faqs.q: Are your plumbers licensed and insured in Texas?
faqs.a: Yes. Every plumber on Luke's team is licensed through the Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners and fully insured. We also background-check all of our technicians, because you are inviting us into your home.

faqs.q: Are your AC technicians licensed and certified?
faqs.a: Yes. All Luke's Plumbing & Air Conditioning technicians are fully licensed by the State of Texas and NATE-certified for both residential and light commercial systems. We also maintain ongoing training so our team stays current with the latest HVAC technology and energy-efficiency standards.

faqs.q: Do you offer same-day or emergency service?
faqs.a: For non-emergency repairs we offer same-day service in most cases. For plumbing emergencies, burst pipes, major leaks and sewer backups, our team is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and holidays, and we do not charge extra for after-hours service.

faqs.q: Do you offer plumbing services for commercial properties in Houston?
faqs.a: Yes. We service both residential and commercial customers. Our commercial plumbing work includes boiler servicing, plumbing repairs and routine inspections for businesses throughout the Houston area.

faqs.q: Do you offer free estimates or second opinions?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide free estimates for duct repair, replacement and cleaning, and a free second opinion. If another company has given you a quote and you want a second opinion, we are happy to take a look and give you an honest assessment.

faqs.q: Do you serve the entire Houston area or specific neighborhoods?
faqs.a: We proudly serve the Greater Houston metro, including Katy, Cypress, Pearland, The Woodlands, Sugar Land, Bellaire, Memorial and surrounding communities. No matter where you are in Houston, our technicians can usually arrive same-day or within hours for emergency service.

faqs.q: Can Luke's help me decide between repair and replacement?
faqs.a: Yes. Luke's can inspect your current system, explain the condition of the equipment, review repair options and help you compare whether repair or replacement makes more sense for your comfort, budget and long-term energy costs.
